consensus_summary: The dragon primarily symbolizes Satan or the Devil, the ultimate adversary of God. Secondary usages or backgrounds include hostile pagan empires and rulers (like Pharaoh or Babylon) and primordial chaos monsters.
book_summary: The dragon symbolizes the Devil and Satan, specifically functioning as the devouring spiritual force that empowers earthly beasts and oppressive human kingdoms.
book_core_identification: The Devil and Satan (as the spiritual power behind earthly kingdoms)
rationale: Both the book and the consensus identify the dragon primarily as the Devil/Satan. The book's inclusion of the dragon as the power behind earthly kingdoms perfectly matches the consensus's recognition of Revelation 13 and the Old Testament references to Pharaoh and Babylon as expressions of this satanic power.
